poland.name: Invasion of Poland
poland.description: The invasion of Poland by Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union marked the beginning of World War II. Using Blitzkrieg tactics, German forces quickly overwhelmed Polish defenses.

events.title: Germany invades Poland
events.description: German forces cross the Polish border at dawn

events.title: Britain and France declare war
events.description: Allies fulfill their guarantees to Poland

events.title: Soviet Union invades
events.description: Red Army enters Poland from the east

events.title: Warsaw surrenders
events.description: Polish capital falls after heavy fighting

france.name: Battle of France
france.description: Germany's rapid Blitzkrieg campaign defeated France and its allies in just six weeks, leading to the fall of Paris and French surrender.

events.title: Germany attacks
events.description: Army Group A crosses the Ardennes

events.title: Dunkirk evacuation
events.description: Allied troops rescued from French beaches

britain.name: Battle of Britain
britain.description: The first major battle fought entirely in the air. The RAF successfully defended Britain against the German Luftwaffe, preventing invasion.

events.title: Battle begins
events.description: German air attacks on British shipping

events.title: Eagle Day
events.description: Massive Luftwaffe raids on RAF airfields

moscow.name: Battle of Moscow
moscow.description: The Soviet defense of Moscow marked the first major defeat of German forces in WWII. The Red Army's winter counteroffensive pushed the Germans back.

events.title: Typhoon Offensive
events.description: German forces launch attack on Moscow

events.title: Red Square Parade
events.description: Stalin addresses troops en route to front

stalingrad.name: Battle of Stalingrad
stalingrad.description: Considered the turning point of WWII. The Soviet victory destroyed the German 6th Army and marked the beginning of the end for Nazi Germany.

kursk.name: Battle of Kursk
kursk.description: The largest tank battle in history. The Soviet defense halted the last major German offensive on the Eastern Front.

normandy.name: Normandy Landings
normandy.description: The largest amphibious invasion in history. D-Day marked the beginning of the liberation of Western Europe.

events.title: D-Day
events.description: Allied forces land on Normandy beaches

events.title: Beach landings
events.description: American, British, and Canadian troops secure five beaches

events.title: Beachhead secured
events.description: Allies establish firm foothold in France

events.title: Paris liberated
events.description: French capital freed from German occupation

bulge.name: Battle of the Bulge
bulge.description: Hitler's last major offensive in the West. The Battle of the Bulge was the largest battle fought by the US Army in WWII.

events.title: German retreat
events.description: Allies push Germans back to original positions

berlin.name: Battle of Berlin
berlin.description: The final major battle of WWII in Europe. Soviet forces captured Berlin, leading to Hitler's suicide and Germany's surrender.

events.title: Berlin encircled
events.description: Soviet and American forces meet at Torgau

pearlharbor.name: Attack on Pearl Harbor
pearlharbor.description: Japan's surprise attack on the US naval base at Pearl Harbor brought the United States into World War II.

events.title: Attack begins
events.description: Japanese aircraft strike Pearl Harbor at 7:48 AM

events.title: US declares war
events.description: President Roosevelt asks Congress for war

midway.name: Battle of Midway
midway.description: The turning point of the Pacific War. The US Navy destroyed four Japanese aircraft carriers, halting Japanese expansion.

events.title: US counterattack
events.description: American dive bombers sink three carriers

guadalcanal.name: Guadalcanal Campaign
guadalcanal.description: The first major American offensive of the Pacific War. The campaign secured a critical airfield and marked the beginning of Allied island-hopping.

leyte.name: Battle of Leyte Gulf
leyte.description: The largest naval battle in history. The US Navy destroyed the Japanese fleet, opening the way for the liberation of the Philippines.

events.title: Battle begins
events.description: Japanese fleet attacked in Palawan Passage

iwojima.name: Battle of Iwo Jima
iwojima.description: A bloody battle for a small volcanic island. Iwo Jima provided a critical emergency landing strip for B-29 bombers.

events.title: Flag raised
events.description: US flag hoisted on Mount Suribachi

okinawa.name: Battle of Okinawa
okinawa.description: The last major battle of World War II. Okinawa served as a staging area for the planned invasion of Japan.

alamein.name: Second Battle of El Alamein
alamein.description: The turning point of the North African campaign. Montgomery's victory drove Rommel's Afrika Korps out of Egypt.

events.title: Minefields breached
events.description: Allied forces break through Axis lines
